summary: The owner WhatsApp turn (handleOwnerFastPath) keeps a message the dialogue coordinator marks retryable and submits the same event again every 5 s for at most 5 min, like the Pulse room since 28/10; past the bound it says Samantha is still restarting and that nothing ran. The bounded loop moves to dialogueSurface (dialogueTurnUntilReady), shared by both surfaces.
reason: Amine 28/10 (EVT-3334, replaces D-B): a message received while Samantha updates or restarts is kept and handled once she is ready, then answered. pulse-room-defer-until-ready-20261028 covered the Pulse room only and listed owner WhatsApp turns as unchanged; Amine's own messages during a deploy still got the coordinator's « rien n'a été exécuté » failure. The coordinator already marks these turns retryable for every surface (closed maintenance window, interpretation never dispatched) and commits nothing.

tests.name: openclaw-plugin-mobile-ui/scripts/test-e3-surfaces.cjs
tests.evidence: 46 checks; new: an owner message seen twice as interpretation_not_dispatched is answered on the third submission of the same eventRef; a coordinator still in maintenance yields the still-restarting text within the bound (2-21 submissions with a 200 ms window); a final TECHNICAL_FAILURE is submitted once.

tests.name: test-pulse-room-fast-path.cjs, test-contact-room-fast-path.cjs, test-whatsapp-rooms-paired.cjs, test-model-fast-path.cjs; tsc
tests.evidence: Pulse room keeps its 28/10 behaviour through the shared helper (DEFER_UNTIL_READY re-exported, same object).

capabilities.reason: Surface waiting rule; no route, action or capability.

architecture.reason: Reuses the coordinator's retryable flag and the existing bounded loop; no queue, store, scheduler or retry engine added. The coordinator stays the only owner of the decision; the event is the same (idempotent eventRef).

limitations: App and voice turns keep their behaviour: a person waiting on screen or on the line gets the coordinator reply at once rather than a 5 min hold.
A message that never reached the plugin (Gateway itself down) depends on WhatsApp redelivery, unchanged.
Live proof: an owner WhatsApp message sent during a core deploy is answered once Samantha is ready.
rollback: Revert this commit; the Pulse room keeps the same loop inline as before.
